audience: field service teams that collect forms and data in TrueContext

useCases.title: Review recent form submissions
useCases.text: List the form submissions, filtered by date, form or user. Then open one submission to read its details.

useCases.title: Browse the forms in a FormSpace
useCases.text: List the FormSpaces, then the forms in one of them, with the versions of each form.

useCases.title: Check the data sources behind the forms
useCases.text: List the data sources, or lookups, in one FormSpace. Then read the details of one data source.

useCases.title: Fetch fresh data for a lookup source
useCases.text: Ask TrueContext to fetch fresh data for a dynamic data source now. Each call runs a new fetch, and read-only keys cannot use it.

useCases.title: Check where submitted data goes
useCases.text: List the data destinations of a FormSpace, where submitted data is sent.
